name: Dumbbell Incline Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie face down with your feet planted firmly.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other and arms hanging beneath your shoulders.
Drive your elbows back toward your hips until the dumbbells reach the sides of your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then lower the dumbbells fully under control.
tips: Keep your chin slightly tucked so your neck aligns with your spine.
Keep your chest resting on the pad rather than jerking your upper body upward.
